designationHistory.indexText: The Fish and Wildlife Service established Ash Meadows National Wildlife Refuge by buying 11,177 acres of former farmland from The Nature Conservancy to protect the area's endangered desert fishes and plants.
designationHistory.note: Date and authority are from FWS only (CCP and its compatibility determinations agree). No non-FWS source checked yet.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, Desert NWR Complex Final Comprehensive Conservation Plan, 2009 (ServCat 7305)
